newsitem.title: FRANCE: EMPLOYERS' LOBBY WARNS SOCIALISTS NOT TO ENDANGER COMPETITIVENESS.
newsitem.headline: EMPLOYERS' LOBBY WARNS SOCIALISTS NOT TO ENDANGER COMPETITIVENESS.

text.p: French employers' lobby, the CNPF, warned the new Socialist-led government on Monday not to endanger the competitiveness of French business.

The Conseil National du Patronat Francais (CNPF) stressed the need to strengthen the competitiveness of existing businesses and urged the government to "enact a dynamic and realistic policy that will permit faith in the future".
The CNPF issued the statement after French voters swept the Socialists and their Communist allies to power in a parliamentary election on Sunday.
The CNPF said that "a country is strong only if its businesses are capable of creating wealth and jobs."
